_about: Hand corrections to how songs are grouped, used by fetch_lastfm.py, scenes.py and islandmap.py. album_artist: songs from albums whose name starts with this text count as one artist (Spotify credits soundtrack songs to characters). same_scene_as: put this artist in the same scene as that one (for artists Last.fm mixes up with a namesake, and meme songs that belong on the Isle of Memes).
